content.title: Delta Air Lines price target raised to $87 from $77 at Citi
content.summary: Citi raised the firm’s price target on Delta Air Lines (DAL) to $87 from $77 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. The firm updated targets in the airlines group as part of a Q4 earnings preview. Citi’s business travel barometer has bottomed, the analyst tells investors in a research note. However, the firm still expects the supermajors to issue “conservative” outlooks for 2026.
